definition: [ רָעַף ] verb trickle, drip , synonym of נזל , II. ערף (compare Arabic flow (of blood), bleed (of the nose)); — Qal Imperfect 3 masculine plural יִרְעֲפוּ , of clouds Job 36:28 (with עֲלֵי person; || יִזְּלוּ ), with accusative of material טַל Prov 3:20 figurative מַעְגָּלֶיךָ יִרְעֲפוּן דָּ֑שֶׁן Ps 65:12 (i.e. fertilizing rain); subject of moistened ground, נְאוֺת מִדְבָּר , v Ps 65:13 . Hiph`il Imperative masculine plural הַרְעִיפוּ Isa 45:8 trickle , O heavens, from above (figurative: || יִּוְּלוּ צֶרֶק ).
